weatherWatchersCircle.title: Weather Watchers Circle
weatherWatchersCircle.preparation:
Post the Weekly Weather Observation Chart near the window at child height.
Place Weather Symbol Cards in a basket.
Open blinds for sky viewing (or plan a brief safe outdoor look).
weatherWatchersCircle.teacherLanguage:
What do you notice about the sky?
How does the air feel today?
Do you see anything moving in the wind?
What makes you think it is cloudy?
Which weather picture matches what we see?
What do you predict we might see tomorrow?
weatherWatchersCircle.safetyNotes:
If observing from indoors, ordinary classroom supervision is enough.
If you step outside, follow your center’s outdoor weather procedures and stay with the group.
weatherWatchersCircle.cleanupTips:
Return symbol cards to the basket.
Leave today’s symbol on the chart.
teacherTips: Accept disagreement — children can justify different sky readings.
